name: Vashti
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Vashti the queen also made a feast for the women in the royal house belonging to the king. On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded his seven chamberlains to bring Vashti before him with the crown royal to show the people and princes her beauty, for she was fair to look on.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House

points: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains, and the king was very wroth and his anger burned in him. She disrespected the king before everyone, and a judgment was now set to come.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House

points: He asked what should be done unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she had not performed the commandment of the king by the chamberlains. A judgment had to be rendered because she disrespected him in front of everybody.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House

points: Memucan answered before the king and the princes that Vashti had not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes and all the people in all the provinces of the king.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House

points: Memucan advised the king to let a royal commandment go from him, written among the laws of the Persians and Medes that it be not altered, that Vashti come no more before the king, and that he give her royal estate unto another better than she.

note.label: Esther 1: Vashti Refuses the King and the Law of Order in the House

points: After the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased he remembered Vashti and what she had done and what was decreed against her. His servants counsel that fair young virgins be sought for the king in every province and gathered to Shushan the palace under the custody of the keeper of the women.

note.label: Esther 2: Esther Made Queen and Mordecai Uncovers the Plot

points: Fair young virgins here does not mean little girls but women of marital age, and the maiden who pleased the king would be made queen instead of Vashti, and the thing pleased the king.

note.label: Esther 2: Esther Made Queen and Mordecai Uncovers the Plot

points: The king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour more than all the virgins, so he set the royal crown upon her head and made her queen instead of Vashti, and made a great feast, Esther's feast, and a release to the provinces with gifts. Esther was chosen above all the women, for that is what a daughter of Israel is.

note.label: Esther 2: Esther Made Queen and Mordecai Uncovers the Plot
